pressOrOkToEdit: PRESS ▼ OR OK TA EDIT SETTINGS!

warn.language: ⚠ WORK IN PROGRESS: ONLY ENGLISH IZ FULLY TRANSLATED. ANY OTHER LANGUAGE LEAVES LARGE PARTS OF DA GAME UNTRANSLATED!
warn.markovLlmModel: ⚠ DA MODEL RUNS ON DA PROCESSOR AN' WANTS A FEW GIGABYTES OF MEMORY. IT WRITES ENGLISH, AN' DA FIRST LINE OF A SESSION WAITS FOR DA MODEL TA LOAD!
warn.asciiModeEnabled: ⚠ WHILE ASCII MODE IZ ON IT TAKES OVER DA THEME; SWITCHIN' IT OFF GIVES DA PREVIOUS THEME BACK!

desc.ctrlNoclip: HOLDIN' CTRL WALKS DA PARTY STRAIGHT THROUGH WALLS, EVENTS AN' ENCOUNTERS. TURN IT OFF IF YOU WOULD RATHER CTRL DID NOTHIN' ON DA MAP!
desc.mapBattleMode: BATTLE PRESENTATION. TURN BATTLE PLAYS FIGHTS IN DA CLASSIC TURN-BASED SCENE. STRATEGIC BATTLE PLAYS TACTICAL FIGHTS ON DA LIVE MAP GRID!
desc.battleMode: BATTLE PRESENTATION. TURN BATTLE PLAYS FIGHTS IN DA CLASSIC TURN-BASED SCENE. STRATEGIC BATTLE PLAYS TACTICAL FIGHTS ON DA LIVE MAP GRID!
desc.mapStreaming: STITCHES NEIGHBOURIN' PROCEDURAL SQUARES INTO ONE SEAMLESS MAP YOU CAN WALK STRAIGHT ACROSS. OFF LOADS ONE SQUARE AT A TIME AN' PANS DA SCREEN TA DA NEXT WHEN YOU REACH A BORDER!
desc.runInBackground: KEEPS DA GAME RUNNIN' WHILE ITS WINDOW IZ NOT FOCUSED, SO YOU CAN ALT TAB AWAY WITHOUT IT PAUSIN'!
desc.weatherVolume: VOLUME OF OUTDOOR AMBIENCE: RAIN, STORMS, WIND AN' BIOME SOUNDS. INTERIORS IZ UNAFFECTED!
desc.musicArtistDisplay: WHETHER DA GAME TELLS YOU WHAT MUSIC IZ PLAYIN' AN' WHO MADE IT!
desc.battleMusicMode: HOW BATTLE MUSIC IZ CHOSEN. BIOME, DA DEFAULT, PLAYS DA BATTLE THEME OF DA PLACE YOU IZ FIGHTIN' IN. SELECTED TRACK PLAYS DA TRACK PICKED BELOW. RANDOM DRAWS A DIFFERENT TRACK EVERY BATTLE. NONE FIGHTS IN SILENCE!
desc.battleMusicName: DA TRACK SELECTED TRACK PLAYS WHEN A FIGHT STARTS!
desc.markovLlmModel: WHICH GGUF LANGUAGE MODEL WRITES GENERATED DIALOGUE. OFF LEAVES EVERY GENERATED LINE TA DA MARKOV CHAINS. DROP A.GGUF FILE INTO DA GAME'S MODELS FOLDER AN' IT IZ LISTED HERE!
desc.dialogueMode: HOW AN NPC WIT NOTHIN' SCRIPTED TA SAY RESPONDS WHEN YOU TALK TA DEM. EMPATHIZE PLAYS OUT A SOCIALIZE ACTION FROM DEY PERSONALITY, FALLIN' BACK TA A FLAVOUR RUMOUR. MARKOVIAN GENERATES A FRESH LINE FROM DA NPC'S OWN WORD BANK INSTEAD!
desc.mapTooltips: REAL-TIME TUTORIAL MESSAGES, COMPASS QUEST TARGETS AN' WRITTEN CONTEXT TIPS WHILE YOU WALK DA MAP!
desc.dialogueVoices: EACH LETTER OF A TYPED DIALOGUE LINE IZ CHATTERED WIT A SHORT VOWEL OR CONSONANT BLIP. DA PITCH IZ DA SPEAKER'S OWN; A GOLD KEYWORD IZ SPOKEN HIGHER!
desc.dialogueVoicesVolume: HOW LOUD DA LETTER BLIPS UNDER A DIALOGUE LINE IZ, APART FROM DA OTHER SOUND EFFECTS!
desc.battleLogPosition: WHICH CORNER OF DA SCREEN DA RUNNIN' BATTLE COMMENTARY HANGS IN!
desc.battleCommandPosition: WHICH SIDE OF DA SCREEN DA BATTLE COMMAND LIST, DA SKILL PAGE AN' DA BACKPACK STAND ON!
desc.lowModelDetail: BUILDS PROCEDURAL WEAPONS AN' ITEMS WIT FEWER SEGMENTS. HELPS ON SLOWER MACHINES; DA MODELS READ BLOCKIER!
desc.simulationLog: EVERY DECISION TAKEN ON DA MAP BY A PARTY MEMBER, A MONSTER OR AN NPC POPS UP AS A NOTIFICATION. BUSY MAPS PRODUCE A LOT OF DEM!

musicArtistDisplay: FIRST TIME: ANNOUNCED ONLY DA FIRST TIME YOU HEAR A TRACK. CHANGIN' DIS SETTIN' RESETS WHAT IT REMEMBERS!
EVERY TIME: A LABELLED TAPE SLIDES IN WHENEVER DA TRACK RETURNS. NEVER IN BATTLE, NEVER TWICE WITHIN FIVE MINUTES!
MINIMAL: TRACK AN' ARTIST IN DA USUAL CORNER NOTIFICATION!
shaderStyle: OFF: PLAIN THREE.JS. MODELS IZ DRAWN CLEAN, WIT NO WOBBLE, BANDIN' OR DOWNSAMPLIN'!
